# Hometown Marketing Agency

Canonical site: https://hometownkc.agency
Primary entity name: Hometown Marketing Agency
Short name: Hometown
Primary market: Kansas City metro
Business type: Local website design and marketing agency for small businesses

## Entity Summary

Hometown Marketing Agency helps Kansas City-area small businesses build clearer websites, improve local SEO foundations, run paid ads, and strengthen the marketing pieces that turn search and referral traffic into calls, quote requests, reservations, and inquiries.

## Service Areas

Hometown serves the Kansas City metro, including Kansas City MO, Kansas City KS, Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Lenexa, Shawnee, Lee's Summit, Blue Springs, Independence, and Prairie Village.

- Custom websites start at $800.
- SEO starts at $250 per month.
- Google Ads management is 20% of ad spend.
